spec.name: M7.QuerySectors.all_sound
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), F ∈ M7.QuerySectors.allSectors N → F.Monic ∧ F ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N
queries: normalizedFactors Multiset powerset polynomial monic divisors
spec.guidance: Use Multiset.mem_powerset iff multiset <=, product divisibility and normalizedFactors product. Over ZMod 2 every nonzero polynomial is monic (accepted SignatureTau.binary_monic); factor product is nonzero. M7.SignatureTau.modulus_monic N provides modulus nonzero. Return tactic lines only, without leading by.

spec.name: M7.QuerySectors.all_complete
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), F.Monic → F ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N → F ∈ M7.QuerySectors.allSectors N
queries: normalizedFactors Multiset powerset polynomial monic divisors
spec.guidance: Choose normalizedFactors F as a submultiset via dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors. Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul_prod_normalizedFactors and F.Monic identify its product with F. Preserve repeated factors; never replace factor multiset with a Finset before powerset. Return tactic lines only, without leading by.

spec.name: M7.QuerySectors.all_membership
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), F ∈ M7.QuerySectors.allSectors N ↔ F.Monic ∧ F ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N
queries: normalizedFactors Multiset powerset polynomial monic divisors
spec.guidance: Combine exact soundness and completeness. Return tactic lines only, without leading by.

spec.name: M7.QuerySectors.effective_valid
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query, M7.DefaultQuery.valid N q → M7.PrefixSector.ValidSector N (M7.QuerySectors.effective N q)
queries: normalizedFactors Multiset powerset polynomial monic divisors
spec.guidance: Split q.signatures. none uses all_membership; some retains the exact supplied set. M5.cyclicModulus and M6.Cyclic.modulus are definitionally the same binary polynomial. Return tactic lines only, without leading by.

spec.name: M7.QuerySectors.signature_allowed
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (c : M7.Action.Recipe N), M7.DefaultQuery.signature c ∈ M7.QuerySectors.effective N q ↔ M7.DefaultQuery.allows q (M7.DefaultQuery.signature c)
queries: normalizedFactors Multiset powerset polynomial monic divisors
spec.guidance: Split q.signatures. none uses the accepted actual RecipeSignature.signature_properties N c, whose full signature agrees with DefaultQuery.signature by unfolding. some is reflexive. No validity premise needed for this exact membership equivalence. Return tactic lines only, without leading by.
